scripts.db:seed:local: node --experimental-strip-types db/seed/generate.ts > db/seed/.demo.sql && npm run db:seed:local -w api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p api && tsc -p web && tsc -p tests
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w web && node scripts/embed-web.mjs
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:worker && cd api && wrangler deploy --env demo
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:worker && cd api && wrangler deploy --env production
